scope: For immunoaffinity purification of HLA bound peptides
anti-HLA-I and anti-HLA-II monoclonal antibodies were purified from the supernatant of HB95 (ATCC® HB-95™) and HB145 cells (ATCC® HB-145™) and cross linked to protein-A sepharose 4B beads
The lysates were passed through a plate containing beads cross-linked to anti-HLA-I and then sequentially through a plate with the anti-HLA-II cross-linked beads
HLA complexes and the bound peptides were eluted directly into two pre-conditioned Sep-Pak tC18 100 mg plates
